description: Update core settings for your organization: name, country, default_time_zone, base_currency, first_day_of_month (1-28), auto_close_month_after_days, and the budget alert thresholds (budget_warning_threshold_percent must be less than budget_critical_threshold_percent). The organization is fixed by your context - never pass an organization id. Only the fields you provide are changed; everything else is left as-is.

auto_close_month_after_days.description: Auto-close a month this many days after it ends (0 = never).

base_currency.description: Base ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR).

budget_critical_threshold_percent.description: Utilization % at which a project is flagged Over-Budget (must be greater than the warning threshold).

budget_warning_threshold_percent.description: Utilization % at which a project is flagged At-Risk (must be less than the critical threshold).

default_time_zone.description: Default IANA/Windows time zone id (e.g. America/New_York).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: update_org_settings
